title.zh: 发送数值并控制信号灯
title.en: Send a Number and Control the Signal Light

concept.zh: 用同一组开关完成两个目标
concept.en: Meet two goals with the same switches

brief.zh: 整排灯用来显示二进制数，最左两位还接到信号门上。设置开关和逻辑门，让十进制读数和信号灯同时符合要求。
brief.en: The whole row displays a binary number. Its two leftmost bits also connect to a signal gate. Set the switches and gate so the decimal display and the signal light both match the goal.

hints.zh: 先用位权拼出目标数。再只看最左两位，预测选好的门会输出什么。
hints.en: Build the target number using place values. Then look at the two leftmost bits and predict the selected gate’s output.

hints.zh: 最后一轮可以任选逻辑门。不同的门有时会得到相同的输出。
hints.en: In the last round, you may choose any gate. Different gates can sometimes give the same result.

label.zh: 显示 10，AND 信号灯保持熄灭
label.en: Display 10 with the AND signal off

label.zh: 显示 13，OR 信号灯亮起来
label.en: Display 13 with the OR signal on

label.zh: 显示 25，并任选一个会让信号灯熄灭的门
label.en: Display 25 and choose any gate that keeps the signal off
